description.value:
A tall rectangular shield of sheet-steel on a brace-iron frame with a forearm cuff and a grip, the constabulary pattern. It covers from chin to knee and makes a line of four people into a wall. Heavy enough that nobody carrying one is dodging anything; that was never the plan.

Pairs with any one-handed weapon. No signature, no attunement, no view.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Shield
  • Defense: Guard +5, Evasion -1
  • Requires: Bracing (trained)
  • Tier: IV
  • Cost: 90 Nonlethal marks

⟡ Crowned (+3). Keyed to a true name. It will not be sold.

  • +3 on each of its defense bonuses → Guard +5 (rank-scaled like all armor: Trained half, Proficient full).
  • Grade raises it to Tier IV · soulbound — one bearer, no sale.

item.signature: A wall that agreed to come along.
